entityHints.customers: Names, contact details, addresses. One row per customer.
entityHints.vehicles: Make, model, year, plate, VIN. An owner column links or creates the customer.
entityHints.services: Past jobs and invoices. One row per job, with the vehicle it belongs to.

steps.upload: Choose what to import and upload the file from your current system.
steps.mapping: Check which column becomes which field. Nothing is written yet.
steps.preview: Dry run: this is exactly what the import will do. Review it, then import.
steps.importing: Writing rows. Keep this window open.

upload.drop: Drag and drop a file here
upload.formats: CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or vCard (.vcf), up to 25 MB and 50,000 rows
upload.templateHint: No export yet? Fill in a template and upload that.
upload.sourcesHint: Works with exports from any shop system, accounting tool, Google Contacts, Outlook or a spreadsheet. Column names are recognised in many languages; you confirm the mapping before anything is written.

mapping.aiApplied: {count, plural, one {# column mapped} other {# columns mapped}} by AI. Check them before continuing.
mapping.dryRunHint: The dry run checks every row against your existing data without writing anything.

options.duplicates: When a row matches an existing record

summary.customersToCreate: {count, plural, one {# new customer} other {# new customers}}
summary.customersToUpdate: {count, plural, one {# customer updated} other {# customers updated}}
summary.vehiclesToCreate: {count, plural, one {# new vehicle} other {# new vehicles}}
summary.vehiclesToUpdate: {count, plural, one {# vehicle updated} other {# vehicles updated}}
summary.servicesToCreate: {count, plural, one {# service record} other {# service records}}

preview.limitExceeded: Your plan allows {remaining} more customers, but this import would create {needed}. Remove rows or upgrade your plan.
preview.import: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
preview.nothingWrittenYet: Nothing has been written yet. The import can be undone afterwards from Settings → Data.

importing.title: Importing...
importing.keepOpen: Large files take a minute or two.

result.title: Import complete
result.created: {count, plural, one {# record created} other {# records created}}
result.updated: {count, plural, one {# record updated} other {# records updated}}
result.skipped: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}
result.failed: {count, plural, one {# row not imported} other {# rows not imported}}
result.writeFailures: {count, plural, one {# row failed while writing} other {# rows failed while writing}}
result.undone: Removed {customers} customers, {vehicles} vehicles and {services} service records.
result.undoHint: Undo removes every record this import created. Records it only updated keep their new values.

history.title: Import history
history.description: Spreadsheet imports run on this workshop. Undo removes what an import created.
history.undone: Removed {customers} customers, {vehicles} vehicles and {services} service records.
history.confirmDescription: Removes what {file} created: {customers} customers, {vehicles} vehicles and {services} service records. Records the import only updated are kept.

vehicle.description: Vehicle (year make model in one column)

issues.invalid_email: Email "{value}" is not valid and was left out
issues.invalid_vin: VIN "{value}" is not 17 characters; kept as typed
issues.vehicle_year_invalid: Year "{value}" is not a valid year
issues.vehicle_identifier_required: No plate, VIN or make and model to identify the vehicle
issues.vehicle_not_found: No existing vehicle matches "{value}" and there is not enough to create one
issues.service_title_required: Service title or description is missing
issues.invalid_date: {field} "{value}" could not be read and was left out
issues.invalid_number: {field} "{value}" is not a number and was left out

errors.uploadFailed: The file could not be read
errors.aiFailed: AI could not suggest a mapping

entry.title: Import from a spreadsheet
entry.description: Bring customers, vehicles and service history from any system that exports CSV or Excel. Map the columns, run a dry run, then import. Every import can be undone.
